properties.name: WHAT WORKED (dev_storyflow, reported four times 2026-09-23 to 2026-09-27): `invalidates` with a `note` lets a fix retire ONE row of a failing walk, or part of a finding, while saying on the edge what still holds
properties.statement: Recorded so a regression is checkable. Four independent reports in three sessions, in the reporter's words: 09-23 "`invalidates` with a `note` let me say the fix answers ONE row of a failing walk without pretending the walk passes — exactly the right shape for a partial repair"; 09-25 "let me close yesterday's four-call finding while saying in its note that the full scan found a fifth — the correction rides on the closing edge instead of a new node"; 09-25 (#654) "let the closing edge carry what the finding had left open … and say production is still open until deploy"; 09-27 evening (on flo2.io) "handles a PARTIAL retirement well. I kept the Pass 2 root-cause finding open and still recorded, on the edge, which four defects were answered and which three claims still hold." What must not regress: the note is free text on the INVALIDATES edge, and an invalidation does not claim the whole finding is closed.
